voiceReason: This engine has no stock voices, so each register clones one shared reference clip: bubbly is the bright female clip (ref-f1), laconic is the mid male clip (ref-m1) and late-night is the low male clip (ref-m2).
notes: OmniVoice 0.6B (k2-fsa/OmniVoice, pip omnivoice 0.2.1, 24 kHz). The shim wraps voice cloning from the shared reference clips (the most stable mode), fixed seed, honours speed. Native tags: [laughter] and [sigh]. One CPU line took 88 s warm on a quiet box (16 cores, nothing else rendering, 2026-10-23), so it is gpu tier only. Weights 3.1 GB. NC weights flag: fine for the bench, not for shipping.
